prompts.name: happy
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production asset: transparent eight-frame sprite sheet for a small personal Cinnamoroll desktop pet. Attached dance sheet is STRICT character/style reference only; replace action as specified. White puppy, very long floppy white ears, blue oval eyes, tiny tan mouth, pink cheeks, tiny spiral tail, warm fine cinnamon-brown outline and soft clean shading, match reference proportions and quality. EXACTLY 8 full-body frames in a uniform FOUR columns TWO rows grid, read left to right, top then bottom. Keep every character uniformly SMALL within its own cell, maximum 75% of cell width and height, with at least 40px empty transparent gutter on EACH SIDE of EVERY frame. Entire ears and feet visible, NEVER crossing cell boundary. Uniform scale and fixed camera/ground plane; do not zoom between frames. Transparent background with clean alpha. Exactly two arms, two legs, two ears; no extra hands or duplicate body parts. No text, labels, grid lines, border, backdrop, shadow, watermark or extraneous specks. Eight distinct gradual poses, restrained readable motion. 
Action: A contented feeling-loved loop, front view: hug one small pink heart pillow against chest using exactly two paws, eyes soft blue then close with a content smile, small cheek blush, gentle cuddle squeeze and relax. Heart touches both paws and torso throughout. No floating hearts.
